name: When should I call a professional plumber instead of attempting a DIY repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional plumber instead of attempting a DIY repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber when facing complex issues like burst pipes, sewer backups, persistent low water pressure, or water heater malfunctions. While small fixes like a running toilet might seem manageable, improper DIY attempts can worsen the problem, leading to more extensive and costly repairs. Professionals have the tools, experience, and knowledge to diagnose and fix problems safely and effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for complex issues like burst pipes, sewer backups, or persistent low water pressure, as DIY attempts can worsen problems.
